Loc paths now sweep from roots around the sides before hanging; more groups occupy the head surface, but ends taper sharply and the profile retains smooth patches.
Braid rows have greater visible thickness; broad cap-like areas and simplified braid construction remain.

Actual generated Christopher Reid, P2026-BUF-OL-75203022, has saved locs; shared portrait/body/movement consume that changed geometry without altering player DTO, measurement authority or cache/fallback behavior. Asynchronous captures do not prove synchronized pose equality.
Faces, facial hair and measured bodies remain mannequin-like. Full appearance, continuous natural texture calibration, style prevalence and final career/release remain open.
